scoreIngestionFindings.title: Provider smoke evidence artifact is not read by the public beta score
scoreIngestionFindings.description: Formal provider smoke tracking exists, but the score runner still infers provider smoke from final launch readiness report text.
scoreIngestionFindings.recommendedFix: Wire this formal artifact into score input as an honest gate input without converting missing/operator-reported evidence into a pass.

scoreIngestionFindings.title: Runtime smoke evidence artifact is not read by the public beta score
scoreIngestionFindings.description: Runtime smoke tracking exists, but the score gate has no direct runtime evidence artifact input.
scoreIngestionFindings.recommendedFix: Wire this formal artifact into score input as an honest gate input without converting missing/operator-reported evidence into a pass.

scoreIngestionFindings.title: Admin truth sample evidence artifact is not read by the public beta score
scoreIngestionFindings.description: The score derives admin truth sample evidence from debug entries instead of the formal admin truth sample artifact.
scoreIngestionFindings.recommendedFix: Wire this formal artifact into score input as an honest gate input without converting missing/operator-reported evidence into a pass.

scoreIngestionFindings.title: Targeted behavior evidence is hardcoded false
scoreIngestionFindings.description: The beta score cannot improve from targeted validator evidence because the score input always supplies false.
scoreIngestionFindings.recommendedFix: Add a local evidence contract for focused validators and require freshness/schema validation before awarding credit.

scoreIngestionFindings.title: Provider smoke is derived from launch report text parsing
scoreIngestionFindings.description: Provider smoke status should come from formal provider/runtime evidence artifacts, not inverted string matching in the final launch report.
evidence: hasProviderSmokeEvidence reads final-launch-readiness-report and searches for missing-smoke phrases.
scoreIngestionFindings.recommendedFix: Make provider smoke an explicit schema-driven input that can represent missing, operator-reported, failed, and passed states.

scoreIngestionFindings.title: Visual evidence is based on file existence only
scoreIngestionFindings.description: A visual/manual evidence file can unlock the visual gate without schema, timestamp, route, viewport, or result validation.
scoreIngestionFindings.recommendedFix: Require a formal visual evidence schema before scoring visual/manual smoke.

scoreIngestionFindings.title: Admin truth sample scoring is derived from debug entries
scoreIngestionFindings.description: Debug evidence presence is not the same as a fresh admin truth sample with source freshness and sample count.
scoreIngestionFindings.recommendedFix: Read admin-truth-sample-evidence.generated.json and preserve missing_or_unknown as non-passing evidence.

scoreMathFindings.title: Score remains at source-safety-only despite formal tracking artifacts
scoreMathFindings.description: The score is 25/100 because only the source safety gate scores; formal evidence tracking exists but is not modeled as gate input.
scoreMathFindings.recommendedFix: Keep missing evidence non-passing, but ingest formal artifact statuses so operators can see which gates are tracked, missing, operator-reported, or passed.

scoreMathFindings.title: Stale launch/PR reports cap readiness without an independent freshness lane
scoreMathFindings.description: A stale required generated report can dominate readiness even after narrower evidence artifacts are refreshed.
evidence: freshnessIntegrity status outranks unknown/visual/smoke gates through mostSevereReadinessStatus.
scoreMathFindings.recommendedFix: Add a focused launch/PR freshness refresh path or make the score reason expose stale reports as one cap among multiple blockers.

scoreMathFindings.title: Readiness status reason reports only one cap
scoreMathFindings.description: The public beta score has several active caps, but readinessStatusReason selects a single gate detail.
evidence: readinessStatusReason uses gates.find(...) for the most severe status.
scoreMathFindings.recommendedFix: Expose all active cap reasons in the report and keep the single status as a summary only.

scoreMathFindings.title: Evidence gates are booleans instead of status enums
scoreMathFindings.description: The score cannot distinguish missing, operator-reported, failed, stale, and passed formal evidence for several gates.
evidence: PublicBetaEvidenceInput uses boolean fields for targeted, visual, provider, and admin truth evidence.
scoreMathFindings.recommendedFix: Introduce schema-backed status inputs while keeping only real evidence eligible for score credit.

uiConnectionFindings.title: Admin Debug Control Tower displays an aggregate score instead of the canonical public beta score
uiConnectionFindings.description: The Control Tower reads public-beta-score.generated.json, but its visible overallScore is an average of required report scores.
evidence: overallScore is computed from required report scoreValues, while the component renders model.overallScore.
uiConnectionFindings.currentStatus: connected to generated reports but not canonical beta score
uiConnectionFindings.recommendedFix: Show the canonical public beta score and cap reason separately from any Control Tower aggregate score.

uiConnectionFindings.title: Admin Debug report freshness does not validate currentHead
uiConnectionFindings.description: Generated report cards are aged by generatedAt or file mtime, but source commit/currentHead drift is not represented.
evidence: readGeneratedReport reads generatedAt and mtime, but does not compare currentHead/sourceCommit.
uiConnectionFindings.recommendedFix: Add currentHead/sourceCommit mismatch handling for generated report cards.

uiConnectionFindings.title: Admin Debug score display does not show why the beta score is capped
uiConnectionFindings.description: The primary score display shows a number and stale/missing counts, but not the public beta readinessStatusReason.
evidence: DebugControlTower renders model.overallScore and report counts, not readinessStatusReason.
uiConnectionFindings.recommendedFix: Surface the public beta score cap reason from the canonical report without adding new broad panels.

watchTimeFindings.title: Watch-time rollup contract is canonical, but UI locks need to enforce it
watchTimeFindings.description: The rollup keeps diagnostic estimates out of watchTimeMs unless legacy fallback is explicitly allowed; UI validators still need to prove every panel preserves that distinction.
evidence: source=watch_session_rollup is canonical; legacy_page_duration is a labeled fallback; diagnostic_estimate does not count as verified watch time.
watchTimeFindings.recommendedFix: Add an Admin UI/source validator that forbids diagnostic estimates or legacy duration from rendering as canonical watch time.

watchTimeFindings.title: Admin user metrics still feeds legacy watchSecondsTotal into diagnostics
watchTimeFindings.description: Legacy aggregate watchSecondsTotal is passed as viewer/page duration context. It is diagnostics-only today, but this path needs a validator lock.
evidence: viewerOpenMs and pageDurationMs are derived from analytics.watchSecondsTotal.
watchTimeFindings.recommendedFix: Keep watchSecondsTotal labeled as diagnostics or legacy context and ensure it cannot populate validWatchTimeMs without valid sessions.

watchTimeFindings.title: Admin user metrics test expects legacy watchSecondsTotal as canonical watch time
watchTimeFindings.description: A unit test still expects watchTimeMs from analytics watchSecondsTotal even when no valid watch sessions are supplied.
evidence: tests/unit/admin-user-metrics.spec.ts expects watchTimeMs: 90_000 in a fixture without watchSessionsByUser.
watchTimeFindings.currentStatus: test contract conflicts with watch-session rollup doctrine
watchTimeFindings.recommendedFix: Realign the test and any dependent UI copy so nonzero canonical watch time requires valid watch sessions or labeled legacy fallback.

adminDashboardFindings.title: Admin Debug Now still stacks several truth panels in one view
adminDashboardFindings.description: The panel was reduced, but it still renders Control Tower, System Health, Recovery, Creator Lane, and Diagnostics together.
evidence: DebugTabNow renders Control Tower, System health now, Recovery Evidence, Creator Lane, and Now Diagnostics.
adminDashboardFindings.recommendedFix: Keep Control Tower and compact summaries open; collapse System Health detail, Creator Lane detail, and diagnostics by default.

adminDashboardFindings.title: Control Tower duplicates generated reports across sections
adminDashboardFindings.description: Several report cards are pushed into beta readiness and their native sections, which increases repeated truth panels.
evidence: buildSections duplicates device, content, cost, and telemetry reports into beta_readiness.
adminDashboardFindings.recommendedFix: Keep a single primary placement and use section summary pills for cross-surface relevance.

adminDashboardFindings.title: Recovery evidence is compact but still needs validator coverage in this triage lane
adminDashboardFindings.description: The compact recovery contract exists; this triage should lock it so future evidence additions do not reopen the panel by default.
evidence: Recovery evidence summary has compact and collapsed default data markers.
adminDashboardFindings.recommendedFix: Keep the existing Admin Debug validator checking compact recovery defaults and no nested scroll in the summary.

creatorDashboardFindings.title: Creator dashboard stats can render live without source sample metadata
creatorDashboardFindings.description: The creator settings API returns a stats object without source freshness/sample metadata, while the UI marks earnings and audience live whenever stats exists.
evidence: CreatorDashboardSettingsHub uses state: stats ? "live" : "unavailable" for earnings/audience sections.
/api/creator/settings returns stats counts without sourceFreshness, sampleCount, or unavailable reason fields.
creatorDashboardFindings.currentStatus: fake-live risk when aggregate counts are zero or missing
creatorDashboardFindings.recommendedFix: Add source/sample metadata to the creator settings response and map zero/missing stats to unavailable or needs_review until samples exist.

creatorDashboardFindings.title: Creator dashboard section links loop back to the same dashboard route
creatorDashboardFindings.description: Several operational sections expose an Open section link that points to /dashboard/creator instead of a dedicated connected destination.
creatorDashboardFindings.recommendedFix: Either route each section to a real connected destination or remove the Open section link for inline-only sections.

creatorDashboardFindings.title: Creator settings GET route lacks a focused unit test
creatorDashboardFindings.description: The route test covers PUT ownership/projection behavior, but not GET stats shape, projection payload, or source metadata.
evidence: tests/unit/creator-settings-route.spec.ts imports and exercises PUT only.
creatorDashboardFindings.recommendedFix: Add GET tests before changing creator dashboard stats semantics.

recommendedFixOrder.title: Wire formal smoke/admin truth evidence artifacts into public beta scoring
recommendedFixOrder.rationale: This explains why the score remains 25/100 after formal tracking artifacts were added.

recommendedFixOrder.title: Add creator dashboard source/sample metadata before showing stats as live
recommendedFixOrder.rationale: This is the clearest UI truth risk: stats can be live without source sample proof.

recommendedFixOrder.title: Show canonical public beta score and cap reason in Admin Debug
recommendedFixOrder.rationale: The current Control Tower score can drift from public-beta-score.generated.json.

recommendedFixOrder.title: Realign admin user metrics tests with watch-session rollup truth
recommendedFixOrder.rationale: Tests still encode legacy watchSecondsTotal as canonical watch time in one fixture.

recommendedFixOrder.title: Collapse repeated Admin Debug truth panels without changing data behavior
recommendedFixOrder.rationale: This is clutter and operator comprehension work after the truth defects are locked.
